For grown-ups

Original practice, not an official paper

All questions, diagrams, picture choices, hints and explanations are original Otterly work. There are no copied provider questions, paper screenshots or live AI-generated questions. No Olympiad provider is affiliated with or endorses Space Academy.

SOF’s topic syllabi are the primary Class 1–5 grade reference. Other providers differ in scope. PP1 and PP2 are Otterly readiness activities, not official SOF IMO levels.

How content is checked

The October 2026 rebuild compared five official SOF IMO Class 1–5 samples for 2026–27, five CREST CMO Class 1–5 previous-year papers from 2023–24 Set A, the CREST Junior and Senior KG samples, and a Unified Council UIMO Class 5 sample. These 13 documents total 63 pages; 18 representative rendered pages were visually inspected. SOF, KG and UIMO samples are not administered past examinations; the CREST previous-year papers supplied that comparison.

Answer checks and paper comparison are not independent pedagogical review. Independent educator calibration is still needed for difficulty and breadth. Explore, Reason and Stretch describe foundations, connected reasoning and linked conditions, not validated equivalence to an exam.

Not complete exam preparation. Each chapter lists its actual formats by level. Not every published topic or reasoning format is covered. Follow classroom teaching and check the current official syllabus too.

Understanding reports

Learning reports distinguish hinted answers from independent first choices. They consider up to 20 recent different, unhinted questions per skill and level, and wait for at least five before suggesting extra practice. Repeating the same question does not add evidence. Reports are practice evidence, not IQ scores, diagnoses, ranks or predictions of competition results.

Ask the learner to explain a drawing or check with objects too. Choose Explore or an earlier chapter when a step feels too large.

Private, local saves

Game progress stays only in this browser, in three anonymous explorer slots. Clearing site data or closing a private session may remove it. Download a private backup from Help & saves; there is no cloud sync. The game checks saves before play and stops on save failures rather than pretending progress was saved.

These page examples never change a saved game. Game links carry question settings, not a learner’s answers. There are no names, school details, public profiles, chat, analytics or advertising SDKs in the game. Grown-up guidance · Privacy

Report a confusing question using its grade, chapter, level and wording. Do not send children’s personal information.
